items.2026-11-11-ctva-earnings: The Nov 13 digest says Corteva fell 24.3%, with Q3 revenue of $1.6 billion, down 39%, a 2026 EBITDA guide cut to $1.1 billion to $1.125 billion, a delayed 10-Q and a new chlorpyrifos suit.
items.2026-11-12-csco-earnings: The Nov 13 digest says Cisco's fiscal Q1 revenue was $18.5 billion, up 24%, and adjusted EPS was $1.40 versus a $1.32 to $1.33 estimate.
items.2026-11-19-claims: The Nov 13 digest puts jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET on Thursday, Nov 19.
items.2026-11-30-msci: The Nov 13 digest says MSCI's removal of Strategy takes effect Monday, Nov 30, with up to about $2.8 billion of forced selling estimated.
items.2026-11-12-nvda-huang-resigns: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO and left the board Thursday, effective immediately, after reports of two affairs, one with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while an outside firm searches for a successor.
items.2026-11-12-close: Thursday's close: the Dow fell 0.36% to 52,297.09, the S&P 500 fell 0.35% to 7,592.40 and the Nasdaq fell 0.39% to 25,366.09, and the S&P is still up about 2.9% on the week.
items.2026-11-13-rates: The 10-year Treasury yield hit about 5.1% to 5.13%, the highest since October, and CME FedWatch prices a 100% chance of a hike at the Dec 9 Fed meeting, about 87% for 25 bp.
items.2026-11-13-msft-outage: A Microsoft Global Outlook, Teams and Copilot outage stretched into a second day, and shares were about 2% to 3% lower premarket, around $509, on track for the worst week since July.
items.2026-11-12-china-chip-tape: The Information reports Commerce is finalizing a rule blocking Chinese firms from renting advanced AI chips in overseas data centers, extending controls to seven more countries including Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand, and it could come this month.
items.2026-11-13-h200-probe: Lawmakers of both parties are pushing tougher China AI chip limits after the Huang news, which could build support for the Remote Access Security Act.
items.2026-11-13-remote-access-act: The Remote Access Security Act and a bipartisan push for stricter China AI chip rules are still in play, along with the Neal and Wyden probe of the H200 China revenue-sharing deal.
items.2026-11-12-nvda-rivals: Broadcom rose 5.5% and AMD rose 5.9% Thursday as investors rotated to Nvidia rivals, and William Blair upgraded AMD to outperform.
items.2026-11-13-cbrs-earnings: Cerebras was up 17% premarket after Q3 revenue of $230.9 million versus $214.7 million expected, and it raised 2026 revenue to $940 million to $960 million and named Microsoft as a customer.
items.2026-11-13-nu-nmax-flo: Nu Holdings was up 3% premarket after record Q3 net income of $1.1 billion and 143 million customers, with EPS of $0.22 just missing $0.23.
items.2026-11-13-nvda-commitments: Nvidia's latest filing lists about $530 billion of commitments and guarantees, including about $65 billion of cloud capacity rent-backs with CoreWeave, up to a $105 billion guarantee on OpenAI's Ohio data center leases, and a preliminary deal to invest up to $100 billion more in OpenAI.
